sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding pump housing ph-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation and would like an agreement that covers our full need.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. While as a family-run business we do not share internal cost breakdowns, we have recalculated our offer to reflect your preferred timeline. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

By maintaining the 30-day payment term, we are pleased to propose a revised price of €51.80 per unit. For our complete Angebot, we propose a price of €51.80 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and it is valid from 1 April 2027.

It is always a pleasure to work with valued partners who appreciate the craft and dedication of our foundry. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our long-standing business relationship.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In response to your movement, we are pleased to reduce our price to €51.10 while maintaining the 30-day payment term. 

Specifically, our offer stands at a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. We believe this reflects a fair step toward a mutually beneficial agreement. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful work together and bringing our shared dedication to quality into this next chapter.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
